qmd.particle.up_quark.desc: The Up Quark is the lightest quark. Up and Down quarks combine to form Protons and Neutrons
qmd.particle.antiup_quark.desc: The Anti-Up Quark is the antimatter partner of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.down_quark.desc: The Down Quark is the second lightest quark. Up and Down quarks combine to form Protons and Neutrons
qmd.particle.antidown_quark.desc: The Anti-Down Quark is the antimatter partner of the Up Down.
qmd.particle.charm_quark.desc: The Charm Quark is a heavy version of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.anticharm_quark.desc: The Anti-Charm Quark is the antimatter partner of the Charm Quark.
qmd.particle.strange_quark.desc: The Strange Quark is a heavy version of the Down Quark.
qmd.particle.antistrange_quark.desc: The Anti-Strange Quark is the antimatter partner of the Strange Quark.
qmd.particle.top_quark.desc: The Top Quark is a very heavy version of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.antitop_quark.desc: The Anti-Top Quark is the antimatter partner of the Top Quark.
qmd.particle.bottom_quark.desc: The Bottom Quark is a very heavy version of the Down Quark.
qmd.particle.antibottom_quark.desc: The Anti-Bottom Quark is the antimatter partner of the Bottom Quark.
qmd.particle.electron.desc: The Electron is lightest charged lepton. It is commonly found in orbitals around nuclei, forming atoms.
qmd.particle.positron.desc: The positron is the Antimatter particle of the electron. When a electron and positron meet the annihilate resulting in all there mass being converted into energy in the form of 2 gamma rays.
qmd.particle.electron_neutrino.desc: The Electron Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Electron.
qmd.particle.electron_antineutrino.desc: The Electron Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Electron Neutrino.
qmd.particle.muon.desc: The Muon is basically a heavy electron.
qmd.particle.antimuon.desc: The Anti-Muon is the antimatter partner of the Muon.
qmd.particle.muon_neutrino.desc: The Muon Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Muon.
qmd.particle.muon_antineutrino.desc: The Muon Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Muon Neutrino.
qmd.particle.tau.desc: The Tau is basically a really heavy electron
qmd.particle.antitau.desc: The Anti-Tau is the antimatter partner of the Tau.
qmd.particle.tau_neutrino.desc: The Tau Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Tau.
qmd.particle.tau_antineutrino.desc: The Tau Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Tau Neutrino.
qmd.particle.photon.desc: Photons are the particles that make up light. They are the carries of the electromagnetic force. High energy Photons are called gamma rays.
qmd.particle.gluon.desc: Gluons are the carries of the strong force. The strong force is what keeps quarks bound together to create composite particles like protons and neutrons.
qmd.particle.w_plus_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.w_minus_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.z_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.higgs_boson.desc: The Higgs Boson is the boson of the Higgs Field which is responsible for giving particles their mass.
qmd.particle.proton.desc: The Proton is a Nucleon along with the Neutron make up the nucleus of atoms.
qmd.particle.antiproton.desc: The Anti-Proton is the antimatter partner of the Proton.
qmd.particle.neutron.desc: The Neutron is a Nucleon along with the Protons make up the nucleus of atoms. The Neutron is used in nuclear fission to split fissile nuclei.
qmd.particle.antineutron.desc: The Anti-Neutron is the antimatter partner of the Neutron.
qmd.particle.deuteron.desc: The Deuteron is the nucleus of a Deuterium Atom.
qmd.particle.antideuteron.desc: The Anti-Deuteron is the antimatter partner of the Deuteron.
qmd.particle.alpha.desc: Alpha Particle is another name for the nucleus of helium 4. It is commonly released in the decay of heavy elements like uranium and plutonium.
qmd.particle.antialpha.desc: The Anti-Alpha Particle is the antimatter partner of the Alpha Particle.
qmd.particle.pion_plus.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.pion_naught.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.pion_minus.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.triton.desc: The Triton is the nucleus of a Tritium Atom.
qmd.particle.antitriton.desc: The Anti-Triton is the antimatter partner of the Triton.
qmd.particle.helion.desc: The Helion is the nucleus of a Helium-3 Atom.
qmd.particle.antihelion.desc: The Anti-Helion is the antimatter partner of the Helion.
qmd.particle.boron_ion.desc: A Boron atom with one electron missing.
qmd.particle.calcium_48_ion.desc: A Calcium-48 atom with one electron missing. This is a particularly neutron rich atom useful for creating Super heavy elements.
qmd.particle.kaon_plus.desc: The Kaon + is a meson with strangeness of 1.
qmd.particle.kaon_naught.desc: The Kaon 0 is a meson with strangeness of 1.
qmd.particle.antikaon_naught.desc: The Anti-Kaon 0 is a meson with strangeness of -1.
qmd.particle.kaon_minus.desc: The Kaon - is a meson with strangeness of -1.
qmd.particle.eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavourless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.eta_prime.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.charmed_eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.bottom_eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.glueball.desc: Glueballs are particle made entirely out of gluons.
qmd.particle.sigma_plus.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_plus.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.sigma_naught.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_naught.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.sigma_minus.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_minus.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.delta_plus_plus.desc: Delta ++ is a baryon containing three Up Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.antidelta_plus_plus.desc: Anti-Delta ++ is a baryon containing three Anti-Up Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.delta_minus.desc: Delta - is a baryon containing three Down Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.antidelta_minus.desc: Anti-Delta - is a baryon containing three Anti-Down Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
